exceptions.reason: [Differs from spec text] credential-exchange/request 0.1 on the live community container: a request whose credential_request names credential_configuration_id and proofs is answered malformedRequest (the same answer as the community service in process), so it never reaches the unknownOffer / invalidProof decision the vector expects. specs/credential-exchange/request/0.1/spec.md: "The body is an [OID4VCI] Credential Request, carried verbatim and not re-specified here"; the payload schema requires only `credential_request` and leaves its members to OpenID for Verifiable Credential Issuance 1.0, whose Credential Request (section 8.2) has `credential_identifier` or `credential_configuration_id` and `proofs`, and no `format` parameter (the vector's request has that shape). exceptions.reason: [KW deviation from SPEC.md 5.2] The wallet retains and logs a document whose Type URI carries a MAJOR segment it does not implement and sends no trust-task-error (ceremony.ts, setupTrustTasksInbound). Nothing is executed, so the rejection itself is right. SPEC.md:756 puts the reply inside the MUST: a consumer 'MUST reject any document whose Type URI carries a MAJOR segment it does not implement, returning unsupportedVersion where the transport permits a response'; the DIDComm carriage and the shim permit a response, so the wallet differs from the text (class A). It is not the SHOULD of SPEC.md:1071 (that sentence covers rejections under the other rules of 7.2, which ENV-006 to 009 now judge as a SHOULD advisory). The vector does not read a SHOULD as a MUST here.

[KW deviation (module default)] SPEC.md 7.2 item 7: 'If the document carries a proof member, verify it ... and reject the document with proofInvalid on verification failure'; 4.7.1: 'A consumer that does not implement the cryptosuite a proof names MUST reject the document with proofInvalid'. TrustTasksService.consume defaults to acceptUnverified (TrustTasksService.ts:104); the shim carrier, like the wallet's discovery and propose handlers, passes no policy, so a document whose proof is present and invalid is executed. Only the issue and witness-share handlers install a verifier. The supplementary run keyring-wallet-carrier-verify shows the result with the verifier installed. exceptions.reason: [witness server differs from spec text] witness/session Conformance witness item 2 and Authorization: a session whose issuer is not one of the DIDs in `parties` MUST be refused witness/session:refused. WitnessTaskSessions.handleSession reads `parties` but never compares it with the document's issuer, so any connected party can open a session for a pair it is not in. The wallet's own session document sets the issuer to its connection DID, not a relationship DID in `parties` (witnessCeremony.ts), so a literal fix needs the wire contract to change first. Vector review 2026-11-19: class A (deliberate design choice recorded in the source; a question for the server's maintainers).
